title: Why You Look Less Ripped In Photos
hook: If you guys want good photos for Instagram or for your dating profile, spray tanning can be especially important.
body: Cameras tend to flatten your definition. I looked good in the mirror but nowhere near as defined in my photo shoot pictures, mainly because I was too pale. Definition on camera is all about contrast, which is why fitness models and bodybuilders go very dark.
close: Save this for your next photo shoot, and watch my full spray tanning guide on my channel.
